name: What are the hidden costs of a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What hidden costs should I expect with a home addition in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What hidden costs should I expect with a home addition in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden costs are one of the biggest reasons home addition budgets grow after construction starts. Common surprises include structural repairs, outdated wiring, plumbing reroutes, sewer or drainage upgrades, finish changes, and permit-related revisions. Older homes may also reveal hidden damage once walls or floors are opened. Soft costs can be just as important as construction costs. These may include architectural drawings, structural engineering, energy compliance documents, and plan check revisions. If the project affects daily living, temporary storage or short-term housing may also need to be budgeted. Homeowners should ask for a realistic contingency reserve and a proposal that clearly states what is included and what is not. A bid that looks unusually low often excludes important items. The most reliable budget is one that assumes a few unknowns rather than pretending the job will go exactly as planned.
